subject: Increasing seats + new project keys for Olive Health — integration timeline
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna@olivehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: additional project keys + capacity increase (timeline & ask)

Hi Jenna —

Thanks again for the chat this morning. Per our discussion, Olive Health is planning to roll Redwood into two additional project teams ("Clinical Insights" and "Patient Outreach") and will need:

- Two sandbox API keys (one per team) for integration work
- Two prod API keys after testing (staged, ~2 week separation)
- A 30% increase in concurrent qps capacity for the month following full prod rollout

I've attached the draft SOW that outlines the proposed staging and estimated cost delta (Expansion_SOW_v1.pdf). For our internal coordination: Marcus, can you confirm whether the 30% burst can be granted under the existing Dedicated commitment or whether we need a temporary uplift/credits? Monica, can your team prepare the additional key naming convention and skus for billing?

Proposed timeline:
- Week 1: Sandbox keys provisioned (dev access)
- Week 3: Integration testing completed
- Week 4: Prod keys granted for Clinical Insights
- Week 5: Prod keys granted for Patient Outreach + capacity bump

Please let me know if that aligns with your procurement/implementation window. If you want a faster cadence we can do parallel prod provisioning for both teams but we typically recommend staggered cutovers to minimize risk.

Thanks —
Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Account Lead, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Expansion_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF, 184KB)
From: Jenna Park <jenna@olivehealth.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike O'Neal <mike.oneal@olivehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: additional project keys + capacity increase (timeline & ask)

Hi Aisha —

Appreciate the clear plan. A few quick clarifications from our side:

1) Procurement: we'll need a formal amendment to our existing contract that lists the additional keys and the temporary capacity uplift. Will send a formal PO once we have the amendment (targeting EOW).
2) Security review: our security team will want the Key_Provisioning_Guide (preferably a short runbook) and confirmation that sandbox keys are logically separated from prod (no shared telemetry).
3) Discount asks: we're evaluating a three-month window for adoption across other groups — is there short-term pricing flexibility if we commit to expanding to two more teams by Q4?

Also cc'd Mike from procurement so he can confirm the PO cadence. Assuming the amendment looks standard, we can aim to provision sandbox keys by next Tuesday.

Thanks,
Jenna Park
Head of Product Integrations
Olive Health

>

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Proposal: additional project keys + capacity increase (timeline & ask)

Aisha / Monica —

Quick notes from pricing/sales ops:
- The 30% capacity bump can be handled in two ways: (1) temporary burst credit applied for 30 days (no contract change) or (2) an amendment to increase committed throughput (suitable if they want sustained uplift beyond 60 days).
- Given Jenna's ask about short-term pricing flexibility, I can offer a 10% usage discount on the additional capacity for the first 90 days if they sign the amendment before Aug 31; otherwise we default to standard tier pricing.

Action items:
- Aisha: propose which route we should present (burst credit vs. amendment + discount).
- Monica: draft key naming pattern (suggested: olive-clinical-sb, olive-patient-sb, olive-clinical-prod, olive-patient-prod) and include TTL/policies for sandbox keys.
- I'll prepare a short amendment template with the 10% early-sign incentive.

Marcus
Senior Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna@olivehealth.com>, Mike O'Neal <mike.oneal@olivehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: additional project keys + capacity increase (timeline & ask)

Thanks Jenna / Mike —

We've reviewed internally and recommend the amendment + 10% incentive route since Olive is likely to expand further across the org. Next steps I propose: 

1) Marcus will share the amendment draft (with 10% discount on uplift) by EOD Wed.
2) Mike to submit PO referencing the amendment once it's agreed; we can provision sandbox keys upon receipt of the PO (sandbox access only).
3) Monica will provision the two sandbox keys within 24 hours of PO and share integration notes (Key_Provisioning_Guide.md attached).
4) Prod keys follow when amendment is signed and the PO for prod capacity is processed.

If that sounds good I can create a short mutual action plan doc in HubSpot and a DocuSign envelope for signatures. Jenna — would you prefer a single amendment covering both projects or two smaller amendments per project?

Best,
Aisha
Account Lead, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Key_Provisioning_Guide.md (Markdown, 6KB)
From: Mike O'Neal <mike.oneal@olivehealth.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Jenna Park <jenna@olivehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: additional project keys + capacity increase (timeline & ask)

Aisha / Jenna —

We will prepare a PO for the sandbox keys this week. A few procurement items: 
- Please send the amendment and a DocuSign link to the billing contact (billing@olivehealth.com).
- We need the SOW and the amendment to reference the existing master agreement id: MSA-OLIVE-2024 so our legal team can expedite review.
- Regarding the 10% incentive -- procurement will approve if the amendment includes a 90-day review clause and a mutual termination for convenience at 30 days with 7-day notice.

Once we have the amendment and DocuSign I'll route the PO. Thanks for the clear steps.

—Mike
Director, Procurement
Olive Health
